Multivendor Marketplace app for Shopify- Product Expiry App:- We have introduced a new feature in our Multivendor Marketplace app for Shopify name "Expiry App"

Which enables both admins as well as sellers to set an expiry date for the product while adding any new product or editing the existing product.

Once you will set the expiry date for any product, the product will automatically become unavailable on that set date.

This feature cost is USD 5 per month over and above your current multivendor marketplace plan.

So let's understand its workflow:-

WORKFLOW

Firstly you need to enable the "Expiry App" feature from the 'Feature Apps' section by click on the (...) three dots of the main menu in the app.

Once you will click on Enable button you need to agree on additional charges USD 5 per month which is over and above your current Multivendor marketplace plan.

Now you will be able to add the expiry date for new products as well as for existing products

FOR NEW PRODUCT:-

Configuration-> Product -> Product Listing -> Add product-> Enter expiry Date-> fill the rest details-> save

FOR EXISTING PRODUCT:-

Configuration-> Products -> Products listing -> Click on "Edit button" of "Action" section in front of Product ID -> Product details page will open -> Enter the expiry date-> Save

DEMO

Check out: https://multivendor-marketplace-5.myshopify.com/
